items.exampleEn: The actress won a prize for her first film.
items.exampleZh: 那位女演員以她的第一部電影得獎。

items.exampleEn: The city has a rich artistic history.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市有豐富的藝術歷史。

items.exampleEn: There is a large metal sculpture in the park.
items.exampleZh: 公園裡有一座大型金屬雕塑。

items.exampleEn: The hotel has an outdoor pool.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店有一座戶外泳池。

items.exampleEn: My father listens to jazz while he cooks.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸邊煮飯邊聽爵士樂。

items.exampleEn: The young performer was nervous before the show.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕的表演者在演出前很緊張。

items.exampleEn: This documentary took ten years to make.
items.exampleZh: 這部紀錄片花了十年拍攝。

items.exampleEn: My cousin plays the violin in a school orchestra.
items.exampleZh: 我表親在學校交響樂團拉小提琴。

items.exampleEn: This antique clock is two hundred years old.
items.exampleZh: 這個古董時鐘已經兩百年了。

items.sentenceEn: The orchestra will play at the town hall on Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 交響樂團星期五會在市政廳演出。

items.audioEn: The outdoor concert has been moved to next Sunday because of the rain.
items.audioZh: 戶外音樂會因雨改到下星期天舉行。
items.questionZh: 戶外音樂會改到什麼時候？

items.sentenceEn: His artistic talent showed at an early age.
items.sentenceZh: 他的藝術天分很早就展現出來了。

items.sentenceEn: This café plays jazz every Friday night.
items.sentenceZh: 這家咖啡店每週五晚上播放爵士樂。

items.stemEn: The museum bought an old ____ made of marble.
items.stemZh: 博物館買了一座年代久遠的大理石雕塑。

items.stemEn: I love ____ activities like hiking and camping.
items.stemZh: 我很喜歡健行和露營這類戶外活動。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, I went to an arts festival in the park. In the morning, I watched a short documentary about an old jazz singer. After lunch, a young actress read poems on the outdoor stage. There was also a market where people sold antique toys and small sculptures. In the evening, the city orchestra played music from famous films. My artistic friend Ana bought a souvenir: a tiny painting of the park.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，我去公園參加一個藝術節。早上，我看了一部關於一位老爵士歌手的短紀錄片。午餐後，一位年輕女演員在戶外表演區朗讀詩。那裡還有一個市集，有人賣古董玩具和小雕塑。晚上，市立交響樂團演奏有名電影的音樂。我很有藝術天分的朋友 Ana 買了一個紀念品：一幅公園的小畫。

questions.questionZh: 午餐後誰在戶外表演區朗讀詩？
市立交響樂團演奏了什麼？

items.promptZh: 每位表演者在台上有五分鐘。
referenceEn: Each performer has five minutes on stage.
Every performer gets five minutes on the stage.
rubricZh: performer 表示「表演者」，例如 each performer、every performer 等說法
主詞用 each／every performer 時動詞用單數（例如 has、gets）；寫 All performers have… 等複數說法也正確
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 這部紀錄片介紹海洋裡的動物。
referenceEn: This documentary shows animals that live in the ocean.
This documentary is about animals in the sea.
rubricZh: 用 documentary 表示「紀錄片」
「介紹」可寫，例如 shows、is about 等
